from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687659/attempts/4b6740fb5c394cfaab2dd4985d9f6926/system/state/workspace')
programs=root/'programs'; programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def components(grid, color):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != color or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while q:
                x,y=q.popleft(); comp.append((x,y))
                for nx,ny in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
                    if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and grid[nx][ny]==color and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
            out.append(comp)
    return out

def norm(points):
    mr=min(r for r,c in points); mc=min(c for r,c in points)
    return frozenset((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in points)

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=1
    # Find a three-sided-corner clue frame: a full horizontal and vertical line
    # meeting at a corner. The opposite quadrant contains the reference shape.
    for frame_color in set(v for row in g for v in row)-{bg}:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==frame_color]
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        # Frame fills two adjacent bounding-box edges; interior is opposite corner.
        orientations=[(r0,r1,c0,c1)]
        for side in ('top','bottom'):
            for vert in ('left','right'):
                hr=r0 if side=='top' else r1
                vc=c0 if vert=='left' else c1
                if all(g[hr][c]==frame_color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(g[r][vc]==frame_color for r in range(r0,r1+1)):
                    ir0,ir1=(r0+1,r1) if side=='top' else (r0,r1-1)
                    ic0,ic1=(c0+1,c1) if vert=='left' else (c0,c1-1)
                    if ir0>ir1 or ic0>ic1: continue
                    inside=[(r,c) for r in range(ir0,ir1+1) for c in range(ic0,ic1+1) if g[r][c] not in (bg,frame_color)]
                    if not inside: continue
                    # Reference shape is the connected non-background object inside the frame.
                    ref_color=g[inside[0][0]][inside[0][1]]
                    ref=[p for p in inside if g[p[0]][p[1]]==ref_color]
                    shape=norm(ref)
                    # Replace the matching object of the most common distinct target color (9 in these tasks).
                    for target_color in sorted(set(v for row in g for v in row)-{bg,frame_color,ref_color}):
                        for comp in components(g,target_color):
                            if norm(comp)==shape:
                                for r,c in comp: g[r][c]=frame_color
                                return g
    return g
'''
